scope: Quadratic-character resolvent on cyclic prime-order elliptic subgroup r=1 mod 4; direct-evaluation and x-only rational-map gates
statement: For R(P)=sum over sign classes u of chi_r(u)x([u]P), R([d]G)=chi_r(d)R(G). On E/F_47 with r=61 and D=-19, R(G)=17 and R(2G)=30, and all 60 nonzero scalars satisfy the identity. Direct target evaluation takes about r/2 group additions; any single exact x-only rational output map for chi_r(d) has numerator/denominator degree at least ceil((r-1)/4).
